notes: Transaction Date,Clearing Date,Description,Merchant,Category,Type,Amount (USD),Purchased By (Purchased By came with Apple Card Family). Amount (USD) signed as Apple sees the account: purchases and other charges (Type Debit) positive, payments and credits negative. Description is the raw text with the address, Merchant the clean name. MM/DD/YYYY, quoted only where a cell holds a comma, no thousands separator, LF, newest first. The heading names USD. Lines dated by Transaction Date. No balance in the file.
